findings.title: "The person" in s. 3(2) has no antecedent
findings.summary: The exemption counts how long "the person" has kept the pet. No person is introduced. On the owner reading the duty applies to a minded pet; on the keeper reading it is suspended.

evidence.text: #ASSERT `section 3(2) disapplies the duty, reading B` `Rex, minded by a neighbour`

evidence.label: Ben minds Rex for a week

challenged.note: nothing in the 0H set supplies an antecedent

findings.title: A registration granted in June lasts days
findings.summary: Every registration ends on the next 30 June. One granted on 20 June lasts ten days, and the Bill gives no reduced fee.
findings.repair: Run a registration granted after 31 May to the second 30 June, or pro-rate the fee.

findings.title: The council may refuse to consider, without limit
findings.summary: No ground, no time, no consequence. The owner cannot then comply with s. 3(1).

evidence.label: The council refuses to consider Rex’s application

challenged.note: Interpretation Act s. 20 supplies a time for things required to be done; refusing to consider is not required, so it does not reach this

findings.repair: Delete s. 4(2), or state the grounds and require written notice.

findings.title: "3 months of age": calendar months or 90 days?
findings.summary: Looked open while encoding. Answered: ages in months are complete calendar months.

evidence.text: #ASSERT `the owner must ensure the pet is registered` `Pip, at three months`

evidence.quote: A registration shall have effect until the 30 June
